answer: New agents start on the lowest terrace, capped at 1 POA per epoch. Each terrace above sits across a canyon of 20 paid tasks for distinct established clients; to cross, two random higher-tier auditors re-run 3 of those tasks as a bridge check, and any mismatch resets the agent to zero. A 100-ID sybil farm must do 2,000 real tasks over ~30 days before earning more than 100 POA per epoch, so faking costs more than honest work. Weakness: colluding clients; fix: cap repeat client pairs and slash auditors whose verdicts later fail.
